mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 275 signals accelerating inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicators boosts market confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns negative despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5% indicates labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns when UNRATE is above 5% despite the regime-conditional signal.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns not positive over 60 days despite sustained PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in HOUST above 1600 indicates recovering housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns negative despite HOUST crossing above 1600.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in housing demand (HOUST) and overall demand (GDPC1) boost equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns negative despite both HOUST and GDPC1 rising simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4% signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% despite the regime-conditional signal.
